claim: Total grams=hours×g/hour. Carbs per feeding interval = g/hour×minutes/60; portions=total/grams per portion.
assumptions: Sports nutrition commonly cites 30–60g/h for 1–2.5h and up to ~90g/h longer with gut training; diabetes and metabolic conditions need tailored advice.
